issue_title: [Bug] next_id returns incorrect ID when todos have non-contiguous IDs after deletion

plan.summary: Fix next_id to return monotonically increasing IDs by tracking _max_id in storage

test_first.description: Add failing regression test for monotonically increasing IDs after deletion

implementation.approach: Track _max_id in JSON storage to ensure monotonically increasing IDs even after deletions

verification_commands: uv run ruff check src/flywheel/storage.py tests/test_minimal_framework.py
uv run ruff format --check src/flywheel/storage.py tests/test_minimal_framework.py

source_changes: Added _max_id instance variable to track highest ID ever used
Modified load() to support both new format (dict) and legacy format (list)
Modified save() to store todos in new format with _max_id field
Modified next_id() to return _max_id + 1 for monotonically increasing IDs

backward_compatibility: New format stores todos as {"todos": [...], "_max_id": N}. Legacy list format is still readable and will be migrated on next save.
risks: Changes JSON file format - but maintains backward compatibility for reading
Existing users will have their JSON files migrated to new format on next save

verification.ruff_check_command: uv run ruff check src/flywheel/storage.py tests/test_minimal_framework.py
verification.ruff_format_command: uv run ruff format --check src/flywheel/storage.py tests/test_minimal_framework.py
